top_posts.text:
illumina $ILMN makes the sequencing machines and the consumables labs keep buying to run on them, and its customer list is wide 
 
academic labs, pharma, hospitals, diagnostics labs, government labs and crop genomics companies all buy from it. corning and shin-etsu supply the glass and optical materials inside 
 
to me this looks more like a toolmaker for all of genomics than a bet on one market
